### Planner Response

Implemented — preview blur is now calibrated to match runtime much better at low values.

### What I changed

I fixed this in the shared preview blur mapping:

- **Tiny-radius preview guard** in [applyPhotoPreviewBlur](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/BlurMapping.kt:24:0-33:1)  
  Skips blur when computed radius is too small (which was causing an abrupt/too-strong first blur step in compact preview tiles).  
  @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/BlurMapping.kt#25-34

- **Softer low-end preview curve** in [mapPhotoPreviewBlurToRadius](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/BlurMapping.kt:52:0-61:1)  
  Re-tuned the math to make early slider movement much gentler in preview.  
  @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/BlurMapping.kt#53-62

### Build check

- `:app:compileDebugKotlin` ✅ successful

### Docs updated

- @CHANGELOG.md#13-43  
- @CHAT_HISTORY.md#3-24

I followed your saved rules memory for:
1) minimal root-cause changes (no unrelated UI rewrites), and  
2) mandatory documentation updates after each development step.

If you want, next I can do one more fine-tune pass specifically for the **File List Item** preview blur curve only (without affecting other sections).

### User Input

I see that when i drag the slider to around 46% i see in the preview window absolutely no blur effect and when i go further with dagging it like around 47% i see that suddenly the preview window shows a very hardcore blur effect.
Now i tested it simultaneously by manually looking into the app and i see that the blur effect indeed starts get applied correctly in the app itself how it should be. So it means that the visual stuff in the preview window is the problem here.

### Planner Response

Fixed — the `46% -> 47%` preview blur jump was caused by a **hard cutoff** I had added in the preview path.

### What I changed

1. **Removed the hard threshold** in preview blur application  
   - Deleted the `radius < 0.35.dp => no blur` guard, which created the visible cliff.  
   - @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/BlurMapping.kt#25-29

2. **Kept preview blur soft but fully continuous**  
   - Re-tuned the preview curve so low-end values still stay gentle, but with no discontinuity.  
   - Changed to `pow(3.1f)` and blend `(0.34f, 0.03f)` for smoother progression.  
   - @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/BlurMapping.kt#48-57

### Verification

- Compile check passed: `:app:compileDebugKotlin` ✅

- @CHANGELOG.md#13-41  
- @CHAT_HISTORY.md#3-24

Implemented — the `Go Back` flow now restores editor context instead of only opening `Settings -> Colors`.

### What I changed

1. **Tracked “reopen editor on return” in main navigation state**
   - Added `settingsReturnReopenEditor` and set it when `Test` is tapped from editor flow.
   - Passed this flag into [SettingsScreen](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt:150:0-851:1).
   - Ref: @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt#835-840, @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt#3719-3726

2. **Threaded return-context signal through settings layers**
   - Added `settingsReturnReopenEditor` to:
     - [SettingsScreen](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt:150:0-851:1) params
     - [ColorsSection](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt:1342:0-2479:1) params
     - [ColorPresetRow](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt:2529:0-3316:1) params
   - Ref: @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt#334-338, @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt#1494-1498, @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt#2547-2550

3. **Reopen exact section editor on return request**
   - In [ColorPresetRow](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt:2529:0-3316:1), added a `LaunchedEffect(settingsReturnRequestId)` that:
     - checks section match
     - checks reopen flag
     - restores best matching square context (`currentPhotoUri` first, color fallback)
     - reopens editor (`showEditColorPicker = true`)
   - Ref: @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt#2648-2666

I noticed a lot of things regarding the preset cards:

1. when I create a new color preset card, the card preview window gets exactly copied as the one preset card currently selected. Only the content like the color/photo squares don´t get copied. Maybe it helps if i tell you a thing i also noticed and it is that when switching between every preset card, as soon as i select a new one, the preset card preview blinks very quickly by showing the other preset card preview and at the and it shows the corresponding preview.

2. When i add e.g. a color to the new preset, only on the area "content area color" i see that the preview window of the preset card shows the new background. All other areas don´t show the background in the preset card preview only unless i manually tap on the corresponding square again and tap on select again and now i see the background in the preview window from the preset card.
The good thing is that i checked in the app and i see that indeed every background was set correctly.

3. No matter which changes i made to one preset, if tap on another preset, the previeous preset i made the changes gets completely reseted what means that all my changes get lost.

### Planner Response

Implemented a root-cause fix for the 3 preset-card issues.

### What I changed

1. **Stopped preview cross-contamination/blink when switching cards**
   - Preset card preview now renders from preset data only (not transient live SharedPreferences state).
   - This removes the “briefly shows other preset, then corrects” behavior.
   - Ref: @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt#3971-3974

2. **Persist current preset before switching to another card**
   - On card tap, the currently edited preset is now saved first (if switching to a different preset), then target preset is selected/applied.
   - This prevents edits from being dropped on switch.
   - Ref: @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt#3593-3603

3. **Fixed missing sync paths for non-content sections**
   - Added selected-preset sync/save in callbacks that previously only changed runtime state:
     - `onCustomBgColorChange`
     - `onCustomBgBlurChange`
     - `onFileListItemColorChange`
     - `onFileListBackgroundColorChange`
   - This makes preview + persistence consistent across sections (not just content area).
   - Ref: @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt#1722-1765, @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt#2442-2456, @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt#2639-2653

4. **Wired update callback through presets section**
   - `onUpdatePreset` is now passed into [ColorPresetsSection](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt:3424:0-3769:1) and used by the switch guard above.
   - Ref: @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt#1542-1551, @app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt#3426-3435

### Planner Response

Implemented. Root cause was in the new-preset reset path: color state was cleared, but photo state wasn’t fully cleared/persisted before preset creation, so stale URIs/transforms could be captured.

### What I changed

- **Fully clear all section photo state** during new preset reset in:
  - `@app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt#3224-3341`
- For each section (`customBg`, `contentArea`, `memoArea`, `fileListItem`, `fileListBackground`), reset:
  - `photoUri = null`
  - `photoAlpha = 1f`
  - `photoBlur = 0f`
  - `photoOffsetX = 0f`
  - `photoOffsetY = 0f`
  - `photoScale = 1f`
  - `photoRotation = 0f`
- **Persisted** all these cleared values via existing `save*` methods in the same reset block, so [createPresetFromCurrentSettings(...)](file:///c:/Users/javie/AndroidStudioProjects/TeXter2025/app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt:127:4-232:5) can’t inherit stale photo data.

### Validation

- Compile command run:
  - `./gradlew.bat :app:compileDebugKotlin --console=plain`
- Result: **BUILD SUCCESSFUL** (warnings only).  
  There was a tool I/O timeout *after* completion, but build output confirms success.

### Docs updated (per project rule)

- Added changelog entry:
  - `@CHANGELOG.md#13-43`
- Added chat history entry:
  - `@CHAT_HISTORY.md#3-34`

### User Input

When i add a background photo by tapping a photo -> "+pick photo", than it appears correctly and there is the button "remove". If i tap on it directly after having added the photo, the photo gets removed correctly. But if i after adding the photo accept changes and than tap again on the square where the photo is and than tap on remove, than the photo does not get removed anymore. Only unless i made it outside the editor, so in area colors, than tap holfig the photo square and delete.

### Planner Response

Implemented a root-cause fix for the remove flow.

### What was broken
After reopening a photo square, tapping **Remove** set local `selectedPhotoUri` to null, but **Select/Test** didn’t emit any photo update event when URI was null, so nothing got persisted.

### Fixes applied

1. **Always emit photo result in photo mode** (even when URI is null)
   - `@app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/UnifiedBackgroundEditor.kt#495-506`
   - `@app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/UnifiedBackgroundEditor.kt#526-536`

2. **Handle null/blank URI as explicit remove in edit flow**
   - `@app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt#3214-3281`
   - Added branch:
     - non-empty URI → existing apply path
     - null/blank URI → clear section photo state (`uri/alpha/blur/offset/scale/rotation`) and persist square update with `newPhotoUri = null`

### Validation
- Ran: `./gradlew.bat :app:compileDebugKotlin --console=plain`
- Result: **BUILD SUCCESSFUL** (warnings only; tool reported I/O timeout after completion)

### Docs updated
- `@CHANGELOG.md#13-47`
- `@CHAT_HISTORY.md#3-29`

Please re-test your exact flow:
1. Pick photo in square
2. Select
3. Reopen same square
4. Remove
5. Select

It should now remove correctly without needing long-press delete outside the editor.

### User Input

Now i added a photo, was applied in the app, in the preview window and in the square and could remove it correctly. Then the sqare still remains there without photo, than i add a color, the color gets correctly added and i see it in the preview and in the square. Than if i add a photo again, it gets applied correctly in the app but here the square keeps showing the color i selected before and not the photo.

### Planner Response

Applied — I found and fixed the regression.

### Root cause
The edit callbacks were updating squares by **first color match**:
- `indexOfFirst { it.color == oldColor }`

So when multiple squares shared the same color, the wrong square could be updated.  
That matches your report: app state changed to photo, but the square you edited stayed color.

### Fix
I changed all section edit callbacks to target the **most recent matching square** instead:
- `indexOfLast { it.color == oldColor }`

Updated in `@app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt`:
- `onEditBgColor` @MainActivity.kt#2381-2385  
- `onEditContentAreaColor` @MainActivity.kt#2131-2136  
- `onEditMemoAreaColor` @MainActivity.kt#2197-2201  
- `onEditFileListItemColor` @MainActivity.kt#2580-2583  
- `onEditFileListBackgroundColor` @MainActivity.kt#2774-2777

### Planner Response

You’re right to suspect a state overwrite path — your pasted log is only system touch/back events, so it didn’t contain the alpha-reset cause.

### What I found
The intermittent reset came from preset load/select flows re-deriving FileList item photo alpha from square metadata (`customFileListItemColors`) instead of persisted photo alpha.  
If that square metadata was stale, alpha could appear to “jump back” to default.

### Fix applied
I changed FileList item preset load/select to use SharedPreferences as source of truth for alpha/blur:

- `@app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt#3046-3050`
- `@app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt#3191-3199`

So now when `fileListItemPhotoUri` is active, it reads:
- `file_list_item_photo_alpha`
- `file_list_item_photo_blur`

instead of taking alpha from potentially stale square metadata.

### Validation
- Compile check passed: `:app:compileDebugKotlin` (`BUILD SUCCESSFUL`).

- `@CHANGELOG.md#13-35`
- `@CHAT_HISTORY.md#3-25`

I followed the existing project memory about avoiding transient/preset-switch contamination and using persisted state as source of truth in preset transitions.  

If you want, next I can add a tiny debug log guard around FileList alpha writes/reads so we can confirm stability during longer sessions without noise.

### Planner Response

Got it — thanks for confirming the recurrence. I implemented a stronger fix focused on root cause.

### What was happening
The FileList item transparency was still vulnerable because alpha could drift via a **global** pref value (`file_list_item_photo_alpha`) instead of being reliably tied to the specific preset square.

### Fix applied
I changed the logic to persist and restore FileList item photo alpha/blur **per preset square** (matched by `photoUri`), with prefs only as backward-compat fallback.

#### 1) Preset apply/select now prefers square metadata
- `@app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt#3058-3068`
- `@app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt#3216-3224`

#### 2) Slider changes now sync back into the square + preset list
- Alpha sync and preset persistence:
  - `@app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt#3652-3676`
- Blur sync and preset persistence:
  - `@app/src/main/java/com/j4/texter2025/MainActivity.kt#3685-3709`

This prevents future reopen/switch from depending on a stale global alpha value.
